name: Field Check
description: Finds components with a missing value, footprint or datasheet link and marks them on the canvas. Also gives the design assistant a tool to run the same check.
author: Junction

assistant_tools.name: check_component_fields
assistant_tools.description: List the components of the open document whose value, footprint or datasheet link is missing or a placeholder. Returns each component's reference, position and what is missing.

require_datasheet.description: Also report components without a datasheet link (default false).
